decisions.question: While applying the G41 amend, S31 edited bus-api@v1 G8 ('neither throws except TopicCollision') so it also names G41's TypeError for an off-type value, and flagged it as a possible breaking amend. Is it the breaking-amend run-stop?

options.label: Not a stop; keep the edit
options.consequence: G8 and G41 agree; the stand-in experiment shows every suite that imports nidana_dart_runtime still passes.

options.label: Stop the run
options.consequence: The owner decides a wording change to a guarantee that no implementation could meet as written.

decisions.chosen: Not a stop; keep the edit
decisions.why: The breaking-amend stop guards an existing consumer. No consumer code exists, and before the edit G8 could not be satisfied for an off-type value at all, because G41 already required the TypeError; the edit removes a contradiction rather than taking a promise away. Every consuming contract's fixtures pass against the amended stand-in (docs/auto-run/experiments/runtime-reconcile-amends/).
